summary.text: John Arch is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 14, serving since 2018 (elected 2018, re-elected 2022). His committee assignments are Reference, Rules and Executive Board.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Arch was born October 6, 1955, in Sioux City, Iowa, and graduated from Sioux City North High School in 1973.
He earned a B.A. from Grace University in 1977, an M.A. from Western Conservative Baptist Seminary in 1980 and an MBA from the University of Nebraska Omaha in 1987.
His biography lists his occupation as health care consultant and past service on the boards of the Nebraska Hospital Association and Creighton University Medical Center.
It lists him as married to Brenda Ann Mengel since June 17, 1978, with two children.
